description: Na₃Ca₃Zr₂Si₄(O₅F)₃ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four O and one F atom. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.90 Å. The Na-F bond length is 2.14 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three O and one F atom. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.40 Å. The Na-F bond length is 2.24 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four O and one F atom. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.55 Å. The Na-F bond length is 2.32 Å. There are three inequivalent Ca sites. In the first Ca site, Ca is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.17-2.88 Å. In the second Ca site, Ca is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.62 Å. In the third Ca site, Ca is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to seven O and one F atom. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.15-3.04 Å. The Ca-F bond length is 2.80 Å. There are two inequivalent Zr sites. In the first Zr site, Zr is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted ZrO₆ pentagonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one ZrO₆ pentagonal pyramid. There are a spread of Zr-O bond distances ranging from 1.99-2.29 Å. In the second Zr site, Zr is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Zr-O bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.47 Å. There are four inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two O and one F atom. Both Si-O bond lengths are 1.64 Å. The Si-F bond length is 1.68 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to three O and two F atoms to form edge-sharing SiO₃F₂ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.63-1.93 Å. There is one shorter (1.65 Å) and one longer (1.72 Å) Si-F bond length. In the third Si site, Si is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.63 Å) and two longer (1.66 Å) Si-O bond lengths. In the fourth Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ZrO₆ pentagonal pyramid and  an edgeedge with one SiO₃F₂ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.63-1.70 Å. There are fifteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Ca, one Zr, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na and two Si atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two Si atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Ca, one Zr, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, two Ca, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Ca, and one Si atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Ca and two Si atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Ca, and one Zr atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Ca, one Zr, and one Si atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to one Na, two equivalent Ca, and one Zr atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, one Zr, and one Si atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Ca, and two Zr atoms. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Zr, and one O atom. The O-O bond length is 1.51 Å. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, two equivalent Zr, and one O atom. In the fifteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Ca and two equivalent Zr atoms. There are three inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na, one Ca, and one Si atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Na and one Si atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and one Si atom.
